1: // Simple Neon Dodge game
2: // Canvas element with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
9: 
10:   // player (neon circle)
11:   const player = {
12:     x: 50,
13:     y: height / 2,
14:     radius: 15,
15:     speed: 4,
16:     lives: 3,
17:     color: '#0ff',
18:   };
19: 
20:   // obstacles: array of {x, y, w, h}
21:   const obstacles = [];
22:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
23:   const obstacleInterval = 90; // frames
24:   const obstacleSpeed = 3;
25: 
26:   let distance = 0; // score
27:   let running = true;
28: 
29:   // Input handling
30:   const keys = { ArrowUp: false, ArrowDown: false };
31:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true; });
32:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false; });
33: 
34:   function update() {
35:     // Move player
36:     if (keys.ArrowUp) player.y -= player.speed;
37:     if (keys.ArrowDown) player.y += player.speed;
38:     player.y = Math.max(player.radius, Math.min(height - player.radius, player.y));
39: 
40:     // Spawn obstacles
41:     if (obstacleTimer <= 0) {
42:       const obstacleHeight = 30 + Math.random() * 60;
43:       const y = Math.random() * (height - obstacleHeight);
44:       obstacles.push({ x: width, y, w: 20, h: obstacleHeight, color: '#f0f' });
45:       obstacleTimer = obstacleInterval;
46:     }
47:     obstacleTimer--;
48: 
49:     // Move obstacles
50:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
51:       const o = obstacles[i];
52:       o.x -= obstacleSpeed;
53:       // collision detection
54:       if (
55:         player.x + player.radius > o.x &&
56:         player.x - player.radius < o.x + o.w &&
57:         player.y + player.radius > o.y &&
58:         player.y - player.radius < o.y + o.h
59:       ) {
60:         player.lives--;
61:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
62:         if (player.lives <= 0) running = false;
63:         continue;
64:       }
65:       // Remove off‑screen obstacles
66:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
67:     }
68: 
69:     distance += obstacleSpeed;
70:   }
71: 
72:   function drawNeonCircle(x, y, r, color) {
73:     ctx.save();
74:     ctx.beginPath();
75:     ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
76:     ctx.fillStyle = color;
77:     ctx.shadowColor = color;
78:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
79:     ctx.fill();
80:     ctx.restore();
81:   }
82: 
83:   function render() {
84:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
85:     // draw player
86:     drawNeonCircle(player.x, player.y, player.radius, player.color);
87:     // draw obstacles
88:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
89:       ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
90:       ctx.shadowColor = o.color;
91:       ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
92:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
93:     });
94:     // UI
95:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
96:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
97:     ctx.fillText(`Lives: ${player.lives}`, 10, 20);
98:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(distance)}`, 10, 40);
99:   }
100: 
101:   function loop() {
102:     if (!running) {
103:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f88';
104:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
105:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
106:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
107:       return;
108:     }
109:     update();
110:     render();
111:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
112:   }
113: 
114:   // start game
115:   loop();
116: })();

(End of file - total 116 lines)
